name: Glovis America Vehicle Processing Center - Shreveport LA

fieldNotes.siteSelection: Roster point (7600 Antoine Blvd) lands directly on the former GM Shreveport Operations plant - a confirmed positive ID via web research (KTBS, KSLA, Louisiana Economic Development): Glovis America operates a vehicle processing and distribution hub here, occupying a 125,000 sqft facility plus ~90 adjoining acres within the much larger ~730-acre former-GM complex. Center kept on the main building.
fieldNotes.facilityType: Vehicle Processing Center inside a repurposed former auto-assembly plant. Glovis outfits imported vehicles with dealer-requested equipment and exterior upgrades. dockDoorCount/dockDoors reflect legacy plant truck docks; vehicle movement is mainly by car-carrier and rail.
fieldNotes.railServed: Confirmed - active rail yard on the east side with auto-rack and boxcar railcars parked on multiple tracks (Street View 2024-10), plus rail spurs into the property.
fieldNotes.occupancyState: The former-GM complex is largely vacant / partly disused; perimeter roads are wide but empty and decaying (Street View shows weed-grown disused roads). A February 2024 fire was reported at the former GM plant. Glovis occupies only an operational fraction of the site.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Active vehicle-storage marshaling lot in the NW portion of the property holding several hundred finished vehicles in marked rows (probe vstore.png), with adjacent rail.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Medium-to-low confidence. Could not positively confirm a controlled, staffed truck gate from public Street View - the perimeter access roads are open and disused. Glovis operates a secured processing operation so a controlled gate is assumed (truckGate true, remoteGs true as best estimate). truckGate area could not be boxed.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Not confirmed - no staffed booth identified in available imagery. Left false; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Legacy GM-plant truck docks exist on the building faces; exact active count uncertain given partial disuse. Estimated 10-25 band, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: True - large multi-building former auto-plant campus with interconnected and separate structures plus a newer standalone building.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Rural - edge of Shreffeport in a semi-rural/industrial area surrounded by forest and cleared land.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~730 acres for the full former-GM complex perimeter; Glovis's contracted footprint is ~90 acres + 125k sqft building.

citations.claim: Glovis America locations page lists Glovis America - Shreveport at 7600 Antoine Blvd, Shreveport, LA 71130.
Glovis America opened a processing & distribution hub in 125,000 sqft of the former GM Shreveport plant plus 90 leased acres, processing Hyundai/Kia vehicles.
Active Feb 2026 Hyundai Glovis Shreveport job postings (vehicle movement / warranty technician) confirm ongoing operation.

verification.rationale: Former GM plant closed ~2012, but Glovis acquired/leased part of it in 2017 and still operates the VPC today (current locator + active 2026 reqs); Glovis portion is live, not under another owner.
